title: ESC-Fault: a simulated benchmark for electrostatic chuck fault diagnosis
description: Simulated sensor data from 140 electrostatic chucks (the part of a semiconductor etch or deposition tool that clamps and cools the wafer): about 125,000 wafers, 14 signals at 1 Hz, 7 classes including a sensor-fault decoy, and three causal tasks (diagnosis, early detection, remaining life) with held-out test labels. Code, simulator, baselines and scoring. Full data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/forgottenl5/esc-fault-benchmark
